correctness.rationale: A greedy binary arch terminates upon the first opposite symbol, with arches of length 2+d and a final monochromatic remainder; arch count equals universality index. For a Dyck word of semilength n, total excess arch length plus remainder is 2(n-k); net boundary gains/losses imply maximal height H<=n-k+1. The witness 0^h1^h(01)^(n-h) is sharp at height h. Height≤2 restricts all positive boundary arches to a unique 001 with neutral 01/10 arches, yielding the normal form (01)^a 001 (01 or 10)^b 1 and count sum_{b=0}^{n-2}2^b=2^(n-1)-1, plus (01)^n. The equivalence iota>=n-1 iff H<=2 follows.
